title: BME MTF Equity - Reglamento de funcionamiento
discovery_note: All four versions are served by the live official BME document service. They were located through the venue's own public API (apiweb.bolsasymercados.es/Market/v1/EQ/MtfEquity/Documents, titleSearch 'Reglamento de funcionamiento'), which resolves to /MTF_Equity/docs/documentos/Avisos/<year>/<month>/ files.

versions.verification_note: Self-identifies 'Aprobado el 30 de julio de 2020' on the cover. NOTE: the spec-listed URL (circulares/2020/Reglamento_BME_MTF_Equity.pdf) now serves the CURRENT consolidated rulebook (v4 content, sha256 f28c691b...), not version 1; the sole Wayback capture of it (2020-10-28) is truncated at 1048576 bytes. Canonical v1 is the venue's own Aviso file listed by the BME documents API dated 2020-09-03.

Version-control table lists only versions 1 and 2 and declares the modification of articles 16 and 18 on 22/07/2022. Independently corroborated by the CNMV registry copy (ReglamentosSMN, sha256 d82192f6...), whose text content is equivalent. The spec-listed circulares/2022 URL now returns an HTML landing page; both Wayback captures are truncated at 1048576 bytes.

Self-identifies version 4 dated 26/09/2023 ('BME Scale' -> 'BME Scaleup'). Byte-identical to the Wayback Machine capture (2024-03-10) of the spec-listed bmegrowth.es URL. NOTE: the spec-listed URL now HTTP-redirects to an unrelated document (Circular 3/2023, sha256 6b35a164...) due to a venue redirect misconfiguration. Corroborated by the official English rulebook at bolsasymercados.es/dam/descargas/regulacion/mtf-equity/reglamento/2023/bme-mtf-equity-rule-book-bme-scaleup-en.pdf.
